people.name: David D. Roberts
people.relationship: Son of Robert D. Roberts; compiler of the Roberts Book of Remembrance
people.summary: David D. Roberts, known in family context as The Judge, was a Utah legislator, continued his father's English record book after Robert D. Roberts's death, and compiled the later Roberts genealogy / Book of Remembrance.
historicalRoles: Known in family context as The Judge

sourceRoles.note: The exact page-level transition remains unassigned pending handwriting, date, signature, and contextual review.
Welsh correspondents named David D. or D.D. Roberts are kept separate unless evidence establishes that they are this person.

identitySafeguards.basis: Those correspondence addressees are described as sons of David Roberts in Wales, while this David D. Roberts was the son of Robert D. Roberts in Utah.

people.notes: The Book-derived form David R. Roberts is retained as source wording; the canonical identity follows the project-supplied authorship provenance.

books.originalCompilationNote: The Book of Remembrance is preserved as David D. Roberts's historical compilation. Statements in it are not silently rewritten or replaced.

historicalContext.welshLanguage: David D. Roberts did not know the Welsh language.
historicalContext.travel: David D. Roberts never visited Wales.
historicalContext.researchImplication: Some conclusions may reflect translations by others, incomplete information, or interpretations available to him at the time. This context is explanatory and is not used to disparage his work.

editorialModel.principle: Historical and modern layers are not silently blended. Differences are explained respectfully, including likely translation, naming-convention, place-identification, or incomplete-record causes when evidence supports them.
